title: Making cities feel quieter
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What sounds make a city feel unpleasant even when they are not extremely loud?
Can good urban design make a city feel quieter without reducing activity?
Which would improve city life more: fewer cars, more green spaces, or stricter noise rules?
Do people eventually get used to city noise, or does it continue affecting them?
If you could remove one common city noise permanently, what would it be?
